The genetics deliver a clean, citrus-forward aromatic profile and visually crisp buds with the kind of bag appeal that telegraphs flavor character. Effects Frozen Lemonade delivers an energetic, focused high that enhances sociability and creativity. The cerebral lift is clear-headed and productive without anxious tension; the body baseline stays mobile and easy — making this a strong daytime cultivar for stress, social anxiety, or fatigue relief. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: creamy lemon drop up front, with a sugary citrus middle and a smooth, dessert-leaning finish on the exhale. Smoke is silky and refreshingly bright. The terpene profile reads lemon-and-cream — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Frozen Lemonade harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Frozen Lemonade THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Frozen Lemonade THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds.
